name: Pump
description: Launch a coin that is instantly tradeable in one click for free

methodology.Fees: Bonding-curve trade fees paid by users (pump's slice + creator/cashback slice), graduation fees, and Mayhem-mode fees.
methodology.Revenue: Pump's slice of the bonding-curve trade fee plus graduation fees and Mayhem-mode fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pump's slice kept by the protocol after the buyback share, plus 100% of graduation and Mayhem fees. Era-based split: 100% pre-2025-07-14, 0% from 2025-07-14, 50% from 2026-04-28.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: PUMP token buyback (sourced from onchain burns; aggregates buybacks across all pump products, so it won't sum exactly with ProtocolRevenue here).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator fees paid out to coin creators and cashback returned to traders/holders of the coin.

Fees.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's slice of the bonding-curve trade fee (1% pre-2025-05-13, 0.95% after).
Fees.Pump Fun Creator Fees: Creator slice of the bonding-curve trade fee (0.05% from 2025-05-13, 0.30% from Project Ascend / Sept 2025).
Fees.Pump Fun Cashback: Cashback Coins slice — paid by traders; same 0.30% slot as the creator fee, mutually exclusive per coin (Cashback Coins from Feb 2026).
Fees.Pump Fun Mayhem Fees: Mayhem-mode fees collected at the Mayhem program fee wallet.
Fees.Pump Fun Graduation Fees: Fees received by Pump.fun fee wallets from the token graduation during bonding-curve to Raydium migrations.

Revenue.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's slice of the bonding-curve trade fee — kept by the protocol.
Revenue.Pump Fun Graduation Fees: Graduation fees kept by the protocol when tokens migrate from Pump.fun bonding curves to Raydium.

ProtocolRevenue.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's slice kept by the protocol after the buyback share (100% pre-2025-07-14, 0% from 2025-07-14, 50% from 2026-04-28).
ProtocolRevenue.Pump Fun Graduation Fees: Graduation fees kept by the protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: PUMP token buyback (sourced from onchain burns; aggregates buybacks across all pump products).

SupplySideRevenue.Pump Fun Creator Fees: Creator fees paid out to coin creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Pump Fun Cashback: Cashback returned to traders/holders of the coin (Cashback Coins).

methodology.Fees: Total fees collected from all sources, including LP fees (0.20%) and protocol fees (0.05%) and coin creator fees (0.05%) from each trade
methodology.Revenue: Revenue kept by the protocol, which is the 0.05% protocol fee from each trade
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value earned by liquidity providers, which is the 0.20% LP fee from each trade
methodology.Volume: Tracks the trading volume across all pairs on PumpFun AMM

Fees.ProtocolFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to the protocol
Fees.DexLPFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to liquidity providers
Fees.DexCreatorFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to coin creators

Revenue.ProtocolFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to the protocol

SupplySideRevenue.DexLPFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.DexCreatorFees: Trade fees from PumpFun AMM that goes to coin creators

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Pump Trading Terminal(previously known as Padre).
methodology.Revenue: Trading terminal fees retained by Pump.fun after cashback/referral payouts.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Trading terminal fees retained by Pump.fun after cashback/referral payouts.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All outbound transfers from the cashback/referral wallet.

Fees.Trading Terminal Fees: Fees charged on each trade executed through the trading terminal.

Revenue.Trading Terminal Fees To Protocol: Trading terminal fees retained by the protocol after cashback/referral payouts.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Terminal Fees To Protocol: Trading terminal fees retained by the protocol after cashback/referral payouts.

SupplySideRevenue.Cashback/Referral Payouts: All outbound transfers from the cashback/referral wallet.

methodology.Fees: Pump.fun bonding-curve and PumpSwap trade fees generated by trades placed through the official pump.fun mobile app (transactions invoking the app program). Already counted in the parent pump.fun and PumpSwap listings.
methodology.Revenue: Pump's protocol slice of bonding-curve fees plus the PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pump's protocol slice of bonding-curve fees plus the PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades. The PUMP buyback (holders revenue) stays in the parent adapter only.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator and cashback slices of bonding-curve fees plus PumpSwap LP and creator fees on app trades.

Fees.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's 0.95% slice of bonding-curve trade fees on trades placed through the pump.fun app.
Fees.Pump Fun Creator Fees: Coin-creator slice (0.30%) of bonding-curve trade fees on app trades.
Fees.Pump Fun Cashback: Cashback Coins slice (0.30%, mutually exclusive with the creator slice per coin) of bonding-curve trade fees on app trades.
Fees.PumpSwap Protocol Fees: PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades.
Fees.PumpSwap LP Fees: PumpSwap liquidity-provider fee on app trades.
Fees.PumpSwap Creator Fees: PumpSwap coin-creator fee on app trades.

Revenue.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's slice of bonding-curve trade fees on app trades, kept by the protocol.
Revenue.PumpSwap Protocol Fees: PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades, kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Pump Fun Protocol Fees: Pump's slice of bonding-curve trade fees on app trades, kept by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.PumpSwap Protocol Fees: PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades, kept by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Pump Fun Creator Fees: Bonding-curve creator fees paid out to coin creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Pump Fun Cashback: Cashback returned to traders/holders of Cashback Coins.
SupplySideRevenue.PumpSwap LP Fees: PumpSwap fees paid to liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.PumpSwap Creator Fees: PumpSwap creator fees paid out to coin creators.
